title: GitHub - xmahdi1/wisp: Peer-to-peer encrypted messenger with no accounts, no trusted server
excerpt: Peer-to-peer encrypted messenger with no accounts, no trusted server - xmahdi1/wisp
content_html:
A peer-to-peer encrypted messenger with no accounts and no server to trust.

Your identity is a key you hold — nothing to sign up for, no phone number, and no company that can read your messages or see who you talk to.

What is Wisp?

Most messengers ask for a phone number, route every message through their servers, and keep a record of who talks to whom. Wisp does none of that. There is no account, no directory, and no server that holds your messages or your contacts.

An identity is an Ed25519 keypair, backed up by a 12-word recovery phrase. Peers find each other over a shared Kademlia DHT, verify each other with a safety number, and exchange end-to-end encrypted messages — directly when both are online, through a blind relay when NAT blocks a direct path, or via rotating encrypted dead-drops when the recipient is offline. Relays and DHT nodes are assumed adversarial: they see only opaque blobs at unguessable addresses and learn nothing.

Features

  • No accounts, no phone number — your identity is a keypair, restored anywhere with a 12-word phrase.
  • End-to-end encrypted — Noise XX handshake + the Signal Double Ratchet, with forward secrecy and post-compromise recovery.
  • No trusted server — relays carry padded ciphertext at rotating, unlinkable addresses and hold no accounts or history.
  • Works when you're offline — messages wait in encrypted dead-drops and arrive later, even across a device restart.
  • Verifiable identities — a safety number lets two people confirm out-of-band that no one is impersonating them.
  • Open and swappable — any relay will do, clients route around blocked ones, and you can run your own.

How a message travels

Wisp always takes the cheapest path that works, and the relay drops out whenever it isn't needed:

  1. Direct — both peers online: connect (hole-punching where possible) and stream over an encrypted session. Nothing is stored anywhere.
  2. Relayed live — both online but NAT blocks a direct path: the same encrypted session runs through a relay that only sees ciphertext.
  3. Dead-drop — the recipient is offline: leave a padded, encrypted blob at a rotating, unguessable address for them to collect later.

Platforms

Platform Status
Android ✅ Supported (APK)
Linux ✅ Supported (build from source)
Windows ✅ Supported (build from source)
iOS / macOS / Web ❌ Not supported

Download

Latest builds are on the Releases page. Direct download links (always point to the newest release):

Platform Download Notes
Android (most phones) wisp-arm64-v8a.apk Recommended for modern 64-bit ARM devices
Android (universal) wisp-universal.apk Larger; runs on any device if unsure
Android (32-bit ARM) wisp-armeabi-v7a.apk Older devices
Android (x86_64) wisp-x86_64.apk x86 devices / emulators
Linux (x64) wisp-linux-x64.tar.gz Needs GTK 3, libsecret, libnotify
Windows (x64) wisp-windows-x64.zip Extract and run wisp.exe

Linux: tar -xzf wisp-linux-x64.tar.gz && cd bundle && ./wisp Windows: extract the zip anywhere and run wisp.exe (keep the folder together).

On Android you may need to allow "install from unknown sources." On first launch, Wisp generates your identity and shows a 12-word recovery phrase — write it down. It is the only way to restore your identity, and no one can recover it for you.

Build from source

Prerequisites: the Flutter SDK, the Rust toolchain, and — on Linux — the GTK 3, libsecret, and libnotify development packages.

git clone https://github.com/xmahdi1/Wisp.git
cd Wisp/app
flutter pub get

# Android
flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi

# Linux
flutter build linux --release        # → build/linux/x64/release/bundle/

# Windows (on a Windows host)
flutter build windows --release

The Rust protocol core lives in core/; run its tests with cargo test from that directory.

Project structure

core/    Rust workspace — all protocol logic (crypto, networking, storage, engine, relay)
app/     Flutter app (Android, Linux, Windows) + the flutter_rust_bridge FFI in app/rust
relay/   Relay deployment (Docker) for the standalone wisp-relay binary
Crate Role
wisp-crypto identity, seed phrase, Noise handshake, double ratchet, dead-drop derivation, safety numbers
wisp-proto versioned wire formats: presence, message frame, drop/wake protocols, payloads
wisp-net libp2p: QUIC/TCP + Noise, Kademlia DHT, NAT traversal, presence
wisp-relay-store blob mailbox with TTL, size caps, and per-drop quotas (SQLite)
wisp-relay-node / wisp-relay the blind public node: relay + DHT + drop store + wake
wisp-core pairing, sessions, send decision, dead-drops, in-order receive, retry, search
wisp-cli headless client for testing the whole protocol without a UI

Security & threat model

Wisp uses only well-established cryptography: Ed25519, X25519, Noise XX (Noise_XX_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256), ChaCha20-Poly1305, and the Signal Double Ratchet with header encryption.

Protected: message content (end-to-end, forward-secret); the social graph (rotating, derived drop addresses); central seizure (no server holds messages or contacts); takedown (clients route around blocked relays and bootstrap nodes).

Not fully solved: a global passive adversary may correlate the timing of a write and a matching read; endpoint compromise defeats any wire encryption; bootstrap dependence is the softest censorship point.

The claim is not "no servers." It is "no trusted party, and no single point that can read you, link you, or be leaned on to make you stop."

Status

Wisp is in beta. The core protocol is built and proven on the real internet — identity and crypto, discovery by WispID, NAT traversal, live relayed sessions, the dead-drop mailbox, offline delivery across a device restart, and identity binding with safety numbers. Expect rough edges while it's tested on real devices and networks.

Built with a Rust core and a Flutter UI, bridged by flutter_rust_bridge.

content_html_zh:
点对点加密信使，没有帐户，也没有值得信任的服务器。

您的身份是您持有的一把钥匙——无需注册，没有电话号码，也没有公司可以读取您的消息或查看您与谁交谈。

什么是小精灵？

大多数消息传递者都会要求提供电话号码，通过服务器路由每条消息，并记录谁与谁通话。 Wisp 没有做这些。 没有帐户，没有目录，也没有保存您的消息或联系人的服务器。

身份是 Ed25519 密钥对，由 12 个字的恢复短语支持。 对等点通过共享的 Kademlia DHT 找到彼此，使用安全号码相互验证，并交换端到端加密消息——当双方都在线时直接交换，当 NAT 阻止直接路径时通过盲中继交换，或者当接收者离线时通过旋转加密死点交换。 中继和 DHT 节点被假定为对抗性的：它们只能看到无法猜测的地址上的不透明斑点，并且不会学到任何东西。

特征

  • 没有账户，没有电话号码——您的身份是一个密钥对，可以通过 12 个单词的短语在任何地方恢复。
  • 端到端加密 — 噪声 XX 握手 + 信号双棘轮，具有前向保密和泄露后恢复。
  • 没有受信任的服务器——中继在旋转的、不可链接的地址上携带填充的密文，并且不保存任何帐户或历史记录。
  • 在您离线时工作 - 消息在加密的死点中等待并稍后到达，即使设备重新启动也是如此。
  • 可验证的身份——安全号码可以让两个人在带外确认没有人冒充他们。
  • 开放且可交换 - 任何中继都可以，客户端绕过受阻的中继，并且您可以运行自己的中继。

消息如何传播

Wisp 总是采用最便宜的有效路径，并且在不需要时中继会退出：

  1. 直接 - 双方都在线：连接（可能的话打孔）并通过加密会话进行流式传输。 任何地方都没有存储任何内容。
  2. 实时中继 — 均在线，但 NAT 阻止直接路径：相同的加密会话通过只能看到密文的中继运行。
  3. Dead-drop——收件人离线：在一个旋转的、不可猜测的地址留下一个填充的、加密的 blob，供他们稍后收集。

平台

平台 地位
安卓 ✅ 支持（APK）
Linux ✅ 支持（从源代码构建）
视窗 ✅ 支持（从源代码构建）
iOS / macOS / 网页 ❌ 不支持

下载

最新版本位于发布页面。 直接下载链接（始终指向最新版本）：

平台 下载 Notes
Android（大多数手机） wisp-arm64-v8a.apk 推荐用于现代 64 位 ARM 设备
安卓（通用） wisp-universal.apk 较大；如果不确定，可以在任何设备上运行
安卓（32位ARM） wisp-armeabi-v7a.apk 较旧的设备
安卓 (x86_64) 小精灵-x86_64.apk x86 设备/模拟器
Linux (x64) wisp-linux-x64.tar.gz 需要 GTK 3、libsecret、libnotify
Windows (x64) wisp-windows-x64.zip 解压并运行wisp.exe

Linux：tar -xzf wisp-linux-x64.tar.gz && cd bundle && ./wisp Windows：将 zip 解压到任意位置并运行 wisp.exe（将文件夹放在一起）。

在 Android 上，您可能需要允许“从未知来源安装”。 首次启动时，Wisp 会生成您的身份并显示一个 12 字的恢复短语 - 写下来。 这是恢复您身份的唯一方法，没有人可以为您恢复。

从源代码构建

先决条件：Flutter SDK、Rust 工具链以及（在 Linux 上）GTK 3、libsecret 和 libnotify 开发包。

git clone https://github.com/xmahdi1/Wisp.git
cd Wisp/app
flutter pub get

# Android
flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi

# Linux
flutter build linux --release        # → build/linux/x64/release/bundle/

# Windows (on a Windows host)
flutter build windows --release

Rust 协议核心位于 core/ 中；使用该目录中的 cars test 运行其测试。

项目结构

core/    Rust workspace — all protocol logic (crypto, networking, storage, engine, relay)
app/     Flutter app (Android, Linux, Windows) + the flutter_rust_bridge FFI in app/rust
relay/   Relay deployment (Docker) for the standalone wisp-relay binary
Crate Role
wisp-加密货币 身份、助记词、噪声握手、双棘轮、死点推导、安全号码
小精灵原型 版本化线路格式：存在、消息帧、丢弃/唤醒协议、有效负载
缕网 libp2p：QUIC/TCP + 噪声、Kademlia DHT、NAT 穿越、存在
wisp 中继存储 具有 TTL、大小上限和每次丢弃配额的 blob 邮箱 (SQLite)
wisp 中继节点 / wisp 中继 盲人公共节点：中继+DHT+drop store+唤醒
缕缕核心 配对、会话、发送决策、死机、按顺序接收、重试、搜索
wisp-cli 无头客户端，用于在没有 UI 的情况下测试整个协议

安全与威胁模型

Wisp 仅使用成熟的加密技术：Ed25519、X25519、Noise XX (Noise_XX_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256)、ChaCha20-Poly1305 和带标头加密的 Signal Double Ratchet。

受保护：消息内容（端到端、前向秘密）；社交图（旋转、派生的投放地址）；集中捕获（没有服务器保存消息或联系人）；删除（客户端绕过受阻的中继和引导节点进行路由）。

尚未完全解决：全局被动对手可能会将写入时间与匹配读取时间相关联；端点泄露破坏了任何有线加密；引导依赖是最软的审查点。

该声明并不是“没有服务器”。 它“没有值得信赖的一方，也没有任何一个点可以解读你、链接你，或者依靠它来阻止你。”

地位

Wisp 处于测试阶段。 核心协议是在真实的互联网上构建和验证的——身份和加密、WispID 发现、NAT 遍历、实时中继会话、死投邮箱、设备重启时的离线传送以及与安全号码的身份绑定。 在真实设备和网络上进行测试时，预计会出现粗糙的情况。

使用 Rust 核心和 Flutter UI 构建，通过 flutter_rust_bridge 桥接。
